semantic.justification: Original ICU78.3 UDataMemory storage/init/assignment/normalization/known-length/raw/payload queries and close retain native field order and destination heap ownership. Actual binary header and UDataInfo views preserve byte layout, endian marker comparison and swapped sizes. RBBIDataWrapper now consumes the real UDataMemory constructor, preserving its selective header checks and post-init adoption even on error. Original native comparison matches 196608 complete header rows and 743 full descriptor/constructor traces. Native mapping cases call original POSIX uprv_mapFile; managed close releases owned byte references and preserves pointer-clearing order. The prior descriptor checkpoint kept file mapping outside its scope. The prior descriptor checkpoint preceded the application-data and TOC integration. Native OS munmap, allocation failure, physical ABI/thread effects and heap access after close are unverified. The public ICU loader uses original package and tree naming, individual-file and common-package dispatch, acceptance, sticky statuses and descriptor ownership. UDATA_DEFAULT_ACCESS retains FILES_FIRST. The POSIX mapping contract binds a synchronous host reader at the mapping boundary, with independent managed byte storage per open. The browser has no ambient synchronous filesystem reader. Original native comparisons cover all four policies, named and linked ICU data, package extension, timezone override and status/callback admission. Production OpenOffice package installation and iterator/service consumers remain pending.
